description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for Git's 'diff --stat-count' functionality. It sets up various repository states and verifies the output of 'git diff' commands with specific options, including handling of file modes, binary files, and unmerged entries.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks their outcome.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to expected results.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Changes file permissions within the test environment.
